what_this_is: A machine-learning estimate of the chance of more than 1 mm of rain on the target date, computed from completed observations recorded on the observation date.
disclaimer: This is a model estimate produced by a student project, not a forecast issued by the Bureau of Meteorology. For official forecasts see bom.gov.au.
observation_source: Bureau of Meteorology, © Commonwealth of Australia

model.name: Neural Network
model.trained_on: weatherAUS historical record, frozen after Stage 3
model.note: Stage 3 measured the best decision threshold near 0.31 rather than 0.5, so no label is imposed here.
